subject: Mental Models
title: Constraint Mapping
description: A short lesson to help you apply Constraint Mapping.

hook.text: An architect was told a building had to be cheap, beautiful, and fast.

buildup.text: Constraint mapping lists every boundary in a problem: budget, time, physics, law, and human ability.

discovery.text: Once mapped, you see which constraints are real and which are assumed. Many 'impossible' limits are just convention.

twist.text: Airbnb faced the constraint that strangers won't stay in homes. They questioned it and built a billion-dollar company.

punchline.text: Map the walls. Many of them are just painted lines.

quiz.question: What does constraint mapping help you identify?
options: Which limits are real and which are merely assumed conventions
